newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: HICOR HALF YEAR SHR DIPS AS TAXMAN BITES.
newsitem.headline: HICOR HALF YEAR SHR DIPS AS TAXMAN BITES.

text.p: NOTE - Clothing to electronics group Hicor Ltd said the
decrease in earnings per share for the period was largely due to
the higher amount of tax paid after the assessed loss in the
clothing division has been fully utliised.
The group added it expected an improvement in the results
for the full year to December 1996.
The first half had benefitted from escaping the effects of
labour unrest in the clothing sector and experiencing
satisfactory demand in textiles, Hicor said
In electronics the group said it would now have 22 stores
open by the end of October.
